en.hubeali: Ali Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Ismail Bin Ibrahim Bin Musa Bin Ja’far Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Abdul Ghaffar who said,

‘The Abbasides came over to Salih Bin Waseyf (the prison warden), and (also) Salih Bin Ali and others from the deviants from these areas came over to Salih Bin Waseyf, during the imprisonment of Abu Muhammadasws (11th Imamasws). So Salih said to them, ‘And what can I do, and I had allocated two men from the evillest as I was able upon finding upon himasws, but they came to a great matter from the worship and the Salat and the Fasting. So I said to these two, ‘What is it regarding himasws?’ So they both said, ‘What can we say about a man who is Fasting during the day and is standing (for Salat) during the night, all of it, not speaking nor pre-occupying (with anything else)? And whenever we look at himasws, our bodies tremble and (something) enters into us what we have no control over ourselves’. So when they heard that, they left disappointed’.
